BML+ cryptographic primitives

p256-m, by Manuel Pegourie-Gonnard, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/mpg/p256-m
Revision: 44af59e0cff5d3b1d653bc333814077ef830e1bd
Only p256-m.c and p256-m.h are compiled. The ARM assembly selector is restricted
to 32-bit ARM; 64-bit hosts use upstream portable C. OS entropy is supplied by
BCryptGenRandom, SecRandomCopyBytes, or getrandom. See p256-m/UPSTREAM.json.

RHash SHA-256, copyright 2010 Aleksey Kravchenko, permissive license.
https://github.com/rhash/RHash
Revision: 7b2801dfcae0a2afd970d69e822edd49132538b5
Only the SHA-256 implementation and required byte-order helpers are compiled.
No full RHash library, other hash algorithms, plugin loader, or TLS backend is
built. See rhash-sha256/UPSTREAM.json and the license shipped alongside this file.

Windows uses system BCrypt for runtime hashing and verification. macOS uses
system CommonCrypto and Security. Linux uses the static primitives above.
Private-key signing is confined to publisher tooling and test executables.
